name: Multiple Linear Regression
when_to_use: Continuous metric dependent variable, two or more predictors (metric and/or dummies); check multicollinearity (VIF/tolerance), stepwise selection, Box-Cox when residuals are not normal.

expected_input.question: What is the linear relationship between the dependent variable and the predictors?

plain_explanation.purpose: Predicts a number using several factors at once and shows the weight of each.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When more than one factor influences the result and you want to separate the effect of each.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A numeric column to predict and two or more factor columns; a few dozen rows at minimum.
plain_explanation.example: Estimate a company's revenue by size, sector and region, seeing how much each one weighs.
